description: This file implements the HdmiCec plugin for managing HDMI CEC communication, including device detection, message handling, and event notifications within a media framework.

classes.name: HdmiCec
classes.description: Main class implementing HDMI CEC management, including device detection, message processing, and event notification.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes different CEC message types such as ActiveSource, ImageViewOn, TextViewOn, etc.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up IARM connections.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and deinitializes the plugin.

methods.name: getActiveSourceStatus
methods.description: Returns whether the device is the active source.

methods.name: InitializeIARM
methods.description: Sets up IARM event handlers.

methods.name: DeinitializeIARM
methods.description: Removes IARM event handlers.

methods.name: cecMgrEventHandler
methods.description: Handles CEC manager events such as daemon initialization and status updates.

methods.name: dsHdmiEventHandler
methods.description: Handles HDMI hotplug events.

methods.name: onCECDaemonInit
methods.description: Handles CEC daemon initialization event.

methods.name: cecStatusUpdated
methods.description: Updates internal state based on CEC status changes.

methods.name: onHdmiHotPlug
methods.description: Handles HDMI hotplug events.

methods.name: setEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for setting CEC enabled/disabled via JSON RPC.

methods.name: getEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for getting CEC enabled status via JSON RPC.

methods.name: getCECAddressesWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for retrieving CEC addresses via JSON RPC.

methods.name: sendMessageWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for sending CEC message via JSON RPC.

methods.name: loadSettings
methods.description: Loads CEC settings from persistent storage.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables CEC functionality.

methods.name: CECEnable
methods.description: Enables CEC, initializes connections and threads.

methods.name: CECDisable
methods.description: Disables CEC, cleans up connections and threads.

methods.name: getPhysicalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the physical address of the device.

methods.name: getLogicalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the logical address of the device.

methods.name: getEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether CEC is enabled.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the device name.

methods.name: getCECAddresses
methods.description: Returns current CEC address info.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a CEC message.

methods.name: sendActiveSourceEvent
methods.description: Notifies about active source status change.

methods.name: cecAddressesChanged
methods.description: Notifies address change events.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Handles incoming CEC frames and triggers events.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Handles received messages and sends notifications.

methods.name: getDeviceList
methods.description: Retrieves list of connected CEC devices.

methods.name: pingDeviceUpdateList
methods.description: Pings a device to check connectivity.

methods.name: addDevice
methods.description: Adds a device to the internal list.

methods.name: removeAllCecDevices
methods.description: Removes all devices from the list.

methods.name: removeDevice
methods.description: Removes a specific device.

methods.name: sendUnencryptMsg
methods.description: Sends an unencrypted CEC message.

methods.name: requestVendorID
methods.description: Requests vendor ID from a device.

methods.name: requestOsdName
methods.description: Requests OSD name from a device.

methods.name: requestCecDevDetails
methods.description: Requests device details (vendor ID and OSD name).

methods.name: threadRun
methods.description: Main thread loop for device polling.

methods.name: threadUpdateCheck
methods.description: Thread for updating device info.
